metadata.question: Does Jabal Qidr have a darker color than Jabal Bayda, as observed in April 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR harmonized for April 2024 over buffered points for Jabal Qidr and Jabal Bayda; fallback to Landsat 9 L2 if Sentinel-2 has no images.
2. Masking strategy: Apply cloud/cirrus mask (QA60 for S2; QA_PIXEL for L9). Compute visible brightness as mean of B2, B3, B4 reflectance.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check collection size (C1), valid pixel counts after masking (C2), and ensure brightness values are finite (else C3).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2024-04-01';
    const end = '2024-05-01';
    // Approximate locations near Harrat Khaybar (Saudi Arabia)
    const qidrPt = ee.Geometry.Point([39.58, 25.25]);   // Jabal Qidr (black volcano)
    const baydaPt = ee.Geometry.Point([39.79, 25.25]);  // Jabal Bayda (white volcano)
    const qidr = qidrPt.buffer(2500);   // 2.5 km radius
    const bayda = baydaPt.buffer(2500);
    const areaUnion = qidr.union(bayda);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function maskS2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));
      const scaled = img.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']).divide(10000).updateMask(mask);
      return scaled.copyProperties(img, ['CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 'system:time_start']);
    }
    let usedDataset = null;
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(areaUnion)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 60))
      .map(maskS2);
    let size = await col.size().getInfo();
    let cloudMetric = null;

    if (size === 0) {
      console.log('S2 Apr 2024: 0 images -> fallback to Landsat 9');
      function prepL9(img) {
        const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
        const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
          .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
          .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))     // cloud
          .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0));    // cloud shadow
        const sr = img.select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4'])
          .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).clamp(0, 1).updateMask(mask)
          .rename(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']);
        return sr.copyProperties(img, ['CLOUD_COVER', 'system:time_start']);
      }
      col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(areaUnion)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 70))
        .map(prepL9);
      size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('L9 Apr 2024: 0 images');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      usedDataset = 'L9';
      cloudMetric = await ee.Number(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER')).getInfo();
      console.log(`L9 Apr 2024: Images=${size}, avg cloud%=${cloudMetric !== null ? cloudMetric.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    } else {
      usedDataset = 'S2';
      cloudMetric = await ee.Number(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')).getInfo();
      console.log(`S2 Apr 2024: Images=${size}, avg cloud%=${cloudMetric !== null ? cloudMetric.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const composite = col.median();
    const vis = composite.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).rename('vis');
    const scale = 1000;

    // Pixel counts to detect C2
    const qCount = await composite.select('B4').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: qidr,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('B4').getInfo();
    const bCount = await composite.select('B4').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: bayda,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('B4').getInfo();

    if (!qCount || !bCount || qCount === 0 || bCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels (1000m): Qidr=${qCount || 0}, Bayda=${bCount || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const qVis = await vis.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: qidr,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('vis').getInfo();
    const bVis = await vis.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: bayda,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('vis').getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const valid = Number.isFinite(qVis) && Number.isFinite(bVis);
    if (!valid) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Valid pixels (1000m): Qidr=${qCount}, Bayda=${bCount}`);
    console.log(`Brightness mean (0-1): Qidr=${qVis.toFixed(3)}, Bayda=${bVis.toFixed(3)}`);
    const isDarker = qVis < bVis;
    console.log(`Qidr darker than Bayda? ${isDarker ? 'true' : 'false'}`);
    console.log(isDarker ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
